prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical full-body historical editorial portrait of an adult East Asian man walking through a carved wooden corridor. He wears a black winged official-style hat and an ivory Ming-inspired round-collar robe with colorful circular dragon embroidery on the chest and shoulders, plus a gold-toned belt. A second adult attendant in dark historical attire follows behind him. Frame the scene through a softly blurred wooden column, with lattice windows and carved architecture receding in the background. Use late-afternoon side backlight, dappled highlights, low-saturation warm brown and ivory tones, shallow depth of field, restrained analog grain, gentle halation, and realistic fabric and skin texture. No modern objects, text, logos, or watermark.
